'''Maximum Security Pod J-P4''' was a [[Prison/Legends|quarantine cell]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was located in the [[Ultraviolent Offenders Containment]] section of the prison.<ref name="TOR" />
